segments.name: Digital financial technologies
segments.description: Operates a digital financial technology platform, including the USBC tokenized deposit offering, digital asset treasury and legacy sensor technology.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, all operations are considered by management to be one operating segment and one reportable segment as contained in the Consolidated Statements of Operations included in the consolidated financial statements.

changes.text: In August 2025 the company was renamed USBC, Inc. and its ticker changed to USBC on the NYSE American.
changes.evidence: Following the closing of the capital investment by Goldeneye in August 2025, we changed our corporate name to USBC, Inc. and our ticker symbol to "USBC" on the NYSE American.

changes.text: In February 2026 the company elected to proceed with a divestiture of its legacy non-invasive sensor business.
changes.evidence: In February 2026, we completed our evaluation of the legacy non-invasive sensor business and we have elected to proceed with a divestiture transaction.
